# Vendored emoji plugin

The files in `lib/` are copied unchanged from `markdown-it-emoji@3.1.0` (MIT).
The license is in `LICENSE`. The board imports the full Unicode shortcode set
locally and disables punctuation shortcuts such as `:)`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it-emoji
- npm release: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it-emoji/-/markdown-it-emoji-3.1.0.tgz
- Archive integrity: `sha512-NhmMEH2ywduD4Nty1E8uB5NqfLhAT1VR0dyvoJyStKOqCzbZmVdn/+8wj7zpDsb/fLBikpCPsWwxqKlvMmbz4g==`
- Copied files: `lib/bare.mjs`, `lib/full.mjs`, `lib/normalize_opts.mjs`, `lib/render.mjs`, `lib/replace.mjs`, `lib/data/full.mjs`, `lib/data/shortcuts.mjs`
